newsitem.title: POLAND: Petrobank name changed to LG Petro Bank SA.
newsitem.headline: Petrobank name changed to LG Petro Bank SA.

text.p: The shareholders of the Polish Petrobank SA, in which South Korea's LG Group has bought a majority stake, changed the name of the bank to LG Petro Bank SA, the bank said in a Monday statement.
The new name will take effect after the approval of the National Bank of Poland, the country's central bank.
Shareholders have also changed the line-up of the bank's supervisory board and changed the bank's statute to allow for trade in domestic and foreign debt instruments. @
Dutch LG Investment Holdings BV, a subsidiary of South Korea's LG Engineering, has 50 percent plus one share in the bank and has offered to buy-back shares from the bank's other shareholders.
The subscription for the buy-back closes on January 20 and transactions are to be finalised by January 23.
